descriptions.text: Desperado Pass. Great. Now you’re running with the type of kids who sit in the back of the bus. What would your mother say? This pass allows access to the Desperado Club. Warning: Holding a Desperado Pass negates the ability to obtain a Vanquisher pass.

recap.text: Donut opens her Asshole's Boxes first, and one holds a tattoo that brands itself over her right shoulder blade as a gold splotch glowing through her fur. Carl's boxes hold the same items, and his tattoo burns onto his neck, where Donut sees a dagger dripping blood. Carl reads the pass, which grants access to the Desperado Club and negates a Vanquisher pass, and Mordecai calls the club off limits.

Mordecai finds Donut's list of 34 classes the shortest he has ever seen; her racial choice, her stats, the Desperado pass and her tiara cut it down. Carl picks Primal and gets over 650, minus every Cleric and Paladin class, because the tattoo on his neck belongs to a club that bars goody-two-shoes sorts. Past a red, glittering door, Clarabelle the crocodilian admits them to the bar and dance floor.

Katia says again that she has no pass to the Desperado Club, and Donut tells her to do something bad and get a tattoo. Carl cuts in that his came after the incident with the goblin babies, and he suggests Club Vanquisher instead. Katia opens ten loot boxes, and the first puts a dagger tattoo on her neck. She grins at Carl and apologizes, and Donut, smelling of lilacs, cheers that they can go dancing.

beats.headline: Branded through the fur
beats.text: Achievements for killing an infant and more than twenty non-combatants pay out in Asshole's Boxes. Donut opens hers first. One holds a tattoo like the goblin pass Carl got earlier, and it brands itself over her right shoulder blade, a gold-coloured splotch glowing through her fur. She is enraged: a disqualifying mark, she is damaged. Carl touches it to read it. Desperado Pass, access to the Desperado Club, and a warning that it negates a Vanquisher pass. That is all it says. His own boxes hold the exact same items, though his tattoo appears on his neck, where he can't see it, burning as it goes on. Donut, examining it close, says it is a dagger dripping blood. Ghastly, she says.
beats.gist: Carl and Donut open Asshole's Boxes and are branded with Desperado Pass tattoos that negate a Vanquisher pass.

beats.headline: Members of the club
beats.text: The description of the moonshine jugs says they are valuable, and Donut points at the dagger tattoo on Carl's neck. The Desperado Club, she says: maybe it will be on the next floor. She bets they will buy all the jugs because they are members of the club. They will be rich. Maybe, says Carl, if they have any jugs left when they are done.
beats.gist: Donut points at Carl's dagger tattoo and bets the Desperado Club will buy every jug.

beats.headline: Off limits
beats.text: Carl asks Mordecai about the tattoo on his neck, the Desperado Club. Nope, says Mordecai. Off limits. They will learn about the third floors soon enough. Sorry. Then he tells Carl he had better open his boxes before Zev gets here, because the cameras always turn off when kua-tin are around.
beats.gist: Mordecai refuses to explain Carl's neck tattoo, then tells him to open his boxes before Zev arrives.

beats.headline: Fewer classes
beats.text: Picking Donut's class, Mordecai finds her list of 34 the shortest he has ever seen. It is a combination of four things, he works out: her racial choice, her stats, the Desperado pass they both have, which precludes several of the classes right off the bat, and the tiara on her head, which narrows it even further. There are still a few great choices on there, he says.
beats.gist: Mordecai finds Donut's list of 34 classes the shortest he has ever seen.

beats.headline: No clerics, no paladins
beats.text: Carl picks Primal, and his list of classes runs to over 650 choices. He would have even more without that tattoo on his neck, Mordecai says. The Desperado Club does not allow goody-two-shoes sorts, so there are no Cleric classes and no Paladin classes, along with a few monk classes, which is unfortunate, as they would have been worth a look.
beats.gist: Carl's Primal pick offers over 650 classes, minus Cleric and Paladin, thanks to his Desperado Club tattoo.

beats.headline: Past Clarabelle
beats.text: The first room of the club's pub is open to any local, Mordecai says; you need no pass, and crawlers without one can pick up quests there to win themselves a tattoo. Past a red, glittering door, Clarabelle the crocodilian sits in front of the second. I see you two both have a pass, she says: the bar and dance floor are open, the casino isn't ready yet. Inside, Donut asks Mordecai whether he has a tattoo too. He had a pass early on, he says. They know him here now.
beats.gist: Clarabelle the crocodilian tells the two pass-holders the bar and dance floor are open, the casino not ready.

beats.headline: Something bad, and a tattoo
beats.text: Donut wants alcohol and dancing. Katia reminds them she has no pass to the club; she has told them several times. You need to do something bad and get a tattoo, says Donut. What did they do to get access, Katia asks. It doesn't matter, says Carl, cutting in: they received it after the incident with the goblin babies. Better she tries for the other club, Club Vanquisher, he says, though he does not know what it takes.
beats.gist: Katia has no pass to the Desperado Club, so Carl points her toward Club Vanquisher instead.

beats.headline: A dagger on Katia
beats.text: Katia receives ten loot boxes, and after showers they gather to watch her open them. She opens the first and looks at Carl, grinning. Sorry, Carl, she says, as the dagger tattoo forms on her neck. I know you wanted to get me into Club Vanquisher. Donut, poofed out, washed and smelling of lilacs, realizes what has just happened. Oh my god, yay. We can go dancing now.
beats.gist: Katia's first loot box puts a dagger tattoo on her neck; Donut cheers that they can go dancing.
